title: zanthoxylum caribaeum subsp. nelsonii
intro: Zanthoxylum caribaeum subsp. nelsonii, commonly known as Nelson's Prickly Ash, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family, characterized by its woody stems, thorny branches, and small white flowers. Nelson's Prickly Ash has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and pain relief, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of Nelson's Prickly Ash include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
